consequence.statement: This is a new opt-in capability; the evidence states no operational consequence for existing setups.

original.statement: Loki Ruler gains the ability to disable the X-Scope-OrgId tenant header in remote write requests.

decision.reason: [ev-b01a3de73bcb] lists this under Features as adding "the ability to disable" the X-Scope-OrgId header in Ruler remote write requests. That wording describes a new option that operators must turn on themselves, and nothing in it changes what happens by default. An environment that does nothing keeps its current behaviour, so the consequence kind is "none" and the class is informational.
